prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize Desktop Pet Behaviors", "Select how active your new pet will be on your desktop screen.", "Behavior Mode"]
1: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Drag your pet anywhere on screen or right-click to access quick companion controls.", "Got It", "Right click anytime to open settings or hide pet."]
2: ["Find Your Ideal Companion", "Answer three quick questions to match with the best desktop pet style.", "See Matches", "Personality Traits"]
3: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Watch your pet roam, play, and assist directly on your monitor background."]
4: ["Signing in secures your saved pets and customizations in the cloud so they are never lost."]
5: ["Building Your Desktop Companion", "Compiling assets and preparing smooth animations for your desktop screen."]
6: ["Upload Companion Photos", "Provide a clear front-facing image for best pet generation results."]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "You earned an exclusive early adoption collar badge for your new pet.", "Starter Companion Badge"]
8: ["Pick Your Companion Journey", "Choose a pre-made pet companion or craft a unique custom pet from scratch.", "Continue"]
9: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to play."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions exclusive rewards, gifts, or early adoption scarcity badges
